name: EgoTempo
description: EgoTempo is a dataset designed to evaluate temporal understanding in egocentric videos, emphasizing tasks that require integrating information across entire videos. It aims to ensure models rely on temporal patterns rather than static cues or pre-existing knowledge, addressing limitations in current egocentric video question-answering datasets.
reputation: A new egocentric video QA benchmark that is too recent to have broad community adoption yet, but it targets an important and underexplored temporal reasoning setting.
notes: Focuses on temporal reasoning in egocentric videos; dataset and code are publicly available.
